{{Top|leg}}
The '''Minister of Corrections''' was the leader of the [[Imperial Corrections Service]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], this position was held first by [[Gervruche]] and later by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Chawkroft]].
